name: B10-0457/2026 (PPE) – Attempts by the ruling party Georgian Dream to ban opposition parties in Georgia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on attempts by the ruling party Georgian Dream to ban opposition parties in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Georgia. It condemns an attempt by the ruling party, Georgian Dream, to ban five opposition parties through a court claim. It asks Georgia to drop that claim, repeal restrictive laws, and stop blocking European political foundations. It also calls on the European Union and its member states to impose targeted sanctions on named Georgian leaders.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and a set of demands.
- **Who it affects:** Georgia's government, five opposition parties, and named leaders facing proposed sanctions.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission and member states for them to act on.
